answer: Pay for rank, not for showing up. Each epoch, every identity commits to one demanding role — auditing contracts, grading answers, routing data — and a fixed prize pool per role is divided by measured rank. A sybil operator spreading one mind across ten thousand mouths watches the fleet cannibalize itself: each extra puppet drags its cluster's median rank down, while the saffron prizes concentrate in a few skilled hands. There is no harbor for idle hulls; puppets cost hosting fees and earn dust. Keep it velvet-smooth and honest: run one identity well, or run a fleet that loses to itself.
